items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: He said, no. He said, you know see me before, man. He said, no. I don't remember.

ctx.x: That's right. What about, did you know the drummer? The drummer? Yeah. Williams was his name.
Oh. He used to play with Sam. Oh, you're talking about Nolan Williams. Oh, no. He's talking about.

I know he's talking about. Before your time. You know before my time? You don't remember who? Alfred. Alfred. Alfred. That's who it was. Alfred Williams. That's not Nolan. Alfred Williams. Left hand. Nolan. Left hand drummer. That's what it was.
